references.method: Data measured at municipal level and aggregated to national
references.point: Point of treatment or disposal (Landfill, dumpsite, incinerator, composting plant)
references.notes: Although SUBDERE speaks of "generation", given the way in which the data is constructed, it refers to "amount of waste collected". Therefore, the value 8,381,822 is divided by the collection rate: 96.5%.
references.collectionNotes: The value of the SUBDERE study corresponds to non-hazardous MSW. An additional 297.68 Mt of hazardous MSW extracted directly from Chile's Pollutants and Emissions Registry (RETC- acronym in Spanish). Value 2022.

references.notes: Value calculated based on total MSW generated per year, divided by 365 and population.

references.source: Solid Waste and Circular Economy Hub. 2021. "Material Flow Management Status: Municipal solid waste (MSW) for Latin America and the Caribbean.” [Hub. 2023. "Estado de la gestión de flujo de materiales:residuos sólidos municipales (RSM) para América Latina y el Caribe, año 2021". HUB DE RESIDUOS SÓLIDOS Y ECONOMÍA CIRCULAR.]
references.page: Material Flow Management Status: Utilisation final % of generated total in 2021 (aggregate): Chile
references.notes: Sanitary landfill (7,039,806 = 84%); backfilling (not specified) (165,886 = 2%); controlled landfill (1,050,027 = 12.5%); dumpsite (126,103 = 1.5%)  = total (838,1822 = 100%). Sum of uncollected (4%); recycled (0.73%) and composted (0.01%) = 4.74%. then land disposal presented as proportion of the remaining 95.26%.
